# WeatherBug

> > WeatherBug delivers hyperlocal weather forecasts, real-time alerts, and interactive radar to keep users informed and safe from severe weather.

WeatherBug is a comprehensive weather intelligence platform offering current conditions, extended forecasts, severe weather alerts, air quality data, pollen counts, and wildfire tracking. The platform serves millions of users with real-time weather information, educational programs, and live traffic integration for informed decision-making.

## Key Topics

- Real-time weather forecasts
- Severe weather alerts
- Weather radar mapping
- Air quality index
- Pollen forecasts
- Lightning alerts
- Wildfire tracking
- Hourly forecasts
- 10-day extended forecast
- Live traffic cameras
- Weather-Ready Nation
- NOAA data integration
- Local weather conditions
- Health sensitivity guides
- Weather Wizard Program

## Current Weather & Forecasts

- [Weather Today & Tomorrow - Local Forecast & Live Weather Radar](https://weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/now): Current weather, local forecast, air quality, pollen, and lightning alerts.
- [Local and National Hourly Weather Forecasts](https://weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/hourly): Detailed hourly weather forecast with temperature, precipitation, and wind.
- [10-Day Weather Forecast & Weekend Weather](https://weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/10-day-weather): 10-day extended forecast with daily highs, lows, and precipitation chances.

## Alerts & Severe Weather

- [Weather Alerts - Live Severe Weather Updates & Map](https://weatherbug.com/alerts): Live severe weather alerts and warnings with interactive map.
- [Fire Near Me? Live Map & Alerts & 5-Day Forecast](https://weatherbug.com/alerts/fire): Live wildfire map, alerts, and 5-day fire risk forecast.

## Weather Maps & Radar

- [Weather Radar: Past, Present & Future Precipitation](https://weatherbug.com/maps): Interactive weather radar map with past, current, and future precipitation data.
- [Live Traffic Cameras & Local Road Conditions Near Me](https://weatherbug.com/traffic-cam): Live traffic cameras and local road condition reports for commute planning.

## Health & Environmental Data

- [Pollen Count & Local Allergy Forecasts](https://weatherbug.com/life/pollen): Local pollen counts and allergy forecasts with daily outlook.
- [Today's Air Quality Report & Map for your location](https://weatherbug.com/air-quality): Real-time air quality index, pollution maps, and health sensitivity guide.

## Education & Resources

- [WeatherBug Weather Wizard Program: Kid's Weather Safety Training](https://weatherbug.com/education): WeatherBug's Weather Wizard Program offers interactive weather safety education for kids.

## Optional

- [Latest World Weather News & Interesting Weather Stories](https://weatherbug.com/news): Weather news and stories from around the world.
- [Cold and Flu Activity and News](https://weatherbug.com/life/cold-flu): Cold and flu season news and health information.
- [Bears Waltz Out of Winter Torpor](https://weatherbug.com/weather-videos/Animals/20260320-Bears-Waltz-Out-of-Winter-Torpor): Weather-related video content about animal behavior and seasonal patterns.
